Angel Island: Many immigrants once waited on Angel Island before entering the United States.
许多移民过去曾在天使岛等候，然后才进入美国。
team up with: I decided to team up with my classmates to finish the science project.
我决定和同学们合作完成这个科学项目。
mark out: They used white paint to mark out the tennis court on the playground.
他们用白漆在操场上划出网球场的界线。
seagull: A seagull flew over the beach and stole a chip from my plate.
一只海鸥飞过海滩，从我盘子里叼走了一块薯条。
a great many: A great many students took part in the sports meeting last week.
上周有许多学生参加了运动会。
a good many: A good many people stood in line to buy tickets for the concert.
很多人排队购买音乐会的门票。
apply for: She plans to apply for a part-time job at the library this summer.
她打算今年夏天申请一份在图书馆的兼职工作。
thankful: I am thankful to my teacher for helping me improve my English.
我很感激老师帮助我提高英语水平。
cutting: She put the cutting in water, and soon it grew new roots.
她把剪下的枝条放进水里，不久就长出了新根。
straightforward: The teacher gave us a straightforward explanation that everyone could understand.
老师给我们做了一个大家都能听懂的简单明了的解释。
pay off: All your hard work will pay off when you pass the exam.
当你通过考试时，你所有的努力都会得到回报。
somatic: Sleep helps the body recover from somatic tiredness after a long day.
睡眠帮助身体在漫长的一天后从肉体疲劳中恢复。
cast down: Don't be cast down by one failure; you can try again tomorrow.
不要因为一次失败而沮丧，你明天可以再试一次。
the media: The media play an important role in spreading news to the public.
媒体在向公众传播新闻方面发挥着重要作用。
side road: Turn left at the next corner and take the side road to the village.
在下一个拐角左转，走岔道去那个村子。
(be) bound to (do): If you keep practising every day, you are bound to make progress.
如果你坚持每天练习，你一定会取得进步。
Jurassic Park: The children were excited to watch Jurassic Park at the weekend.
孩子们周末看《侏罗纪公园》时非常兴奋。
strike…into one’s heart: The sad song struck its meaning into my heart and I never forgot it.
那首悲伤的歌曲含义刻骨铭心，我从未忘记。
calf: The farmer fed the young calf with warm milk every morning.
农夫每天早晨用温牛奶喂养小牛犊。
bring back to life: Scientists hope to bring back to life animals that died out long ago.
科学家们希望使很久以前灭绝的动物复生。
aurochs: The aurochs, a huge wild ox, disappeared from Europe centuries ago.
原牛是一种巨大的野牛，几个世纪前就从欧洲消失了。
great auk: The great auk could not fly and was hunted until it died out.
大海雀不会飞，遭到捕杀直至灭绝。
quagga: The quagga was a kind of zebra that disappeared more than a hundred years ago.
白氏斑马是一种一百多年前就消失了的斑马。
in good condition: This old bicycle is still in good condition after twenty years.
这辆旧自行车二十年后状况仍然很好。
in poor condition: The old house was in poor condition and needed a lot of repairs.
那座老房子状况很差，需要大量修缮。
George Stephenson: George Stephenson built one of the first successful railway engines.
乔治•斯蒂芬森制造了最早成功的火车头之一。
now and then: Now and then we visit our grandparents in the countryside.
我们偶尔去乡下看望祖父母。
set about: After breakfast she set about cleaning the whole kitchen.
早饭后她开始着手打扫整个厨房。
stainless: The kitchen sink is made of stainless steel, so it never rusts.
厨房水槽是不锈钢做的，所以从不生锈。
merrily: The children ran merrily across the field after the rain stopped.
雨停后，孩子们欢快地跑过田野。
courtroom: Everyone stood up quietly when the judge entered the courtroom.
法官走进法庭时，所有人都安静地站了起来。
Alexander Graham: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in the nineteenth century.
亚历山大•格雷厄姆•贝尔在十九世纪发明了电话。
beaten track: Most tourists follow the beaten track, but we prefer quiet paths.
大多数游客走常规路线，而我们更喜欢安静的小路。
dive into: He dived into his bag to find his train ticket before the gate closed.
在检票口关闭前，他迅速把手伸进包里找火车票。
set out (to do): She set out to write a story that would encourage young readers.
她开始着手写一个能鼓励年轻读者的故事。
Morse: The old sailor still remembered how to send a message in Morse.
那位老水手还记得如何用莫尔斯电码发送信息。
tetrahedron: A tetrahedron has four faces, and each face is a triangle.
四面体有四个面，每个面都是三角形。
James Dyson: James Dyson spent years improving his new kind of vacuum cleaner.
詹姆斯•戴森花了数年改进他的新型吸尘器。
out of order: The vending machine is out of order, so we cannot get any drinks.
自动售货机出故障了，所以我们买不到饮料。
get through: I finally got through to my friend after trying her number three times.
在拨了三次电话后，我终于联系上了我的朋友。
